The hedge fund run by Marc Majzner held 46,932 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.27M, down from 118,460 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clearline Capital Lp who had been investing in Orion Engineered Carbons S A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.96B market cap company. (NYSE:OEC) has risen 56.62% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 44.05% the S&P500.
